name: secret chest
lore:
### On the Trans-Planar Cache: Leomund’s Secret Chest

To command the *Secret Chest* is to master the art of the "Elsewhere." As the incantation takes hold, the caster feels the Weave tighten like a silver tether pulled taut across the veil of the Ethereal Plane. It is a sensation of profound displacement—as if the weight of the chest is being lifted not by muscle, but by the very fabric of reality folding inward.

Visually, the manifestation is sublime. The physical chest—crafted of exquisite ivory and gold—does not merely vanish; it bleeds out of existence. Its colors desaturate into ghostly greys until it becomes a translucent shimmer, a ripple in the air that eventually snaps shut like a book.

Legend attributes this artifice to the paranoid archivist Malakor the Hoarder. Besieged by thieves, Malakor realized that no lock is unpickable if the door itself does not exist. He spent decades "thinning" the air of his study until he successfully slipped his life’s work into the margins of the world. Beware, however: should the tiny replica be lost, your treasures remain forever adrift in the starlit silence of the Deep Ethereal.
